who: Eugene Hugh Byrne, historian of medieval Genoese commerce at Wisconsin; Wisconsin history doctorate, 1914-1915.

The 1928-1929 departmental catalogue lists Eugene Hugh Byrne, PhD, as professor of history.
The authority expands Eugene H. Byrne to Eugene Hugh Byrne and identifies his Genoese Shipping in the Twelfth and Thirteenth Centuries (1930).

notes: Full name, institution, period, medieval field, and both named advisees agree.
